weak.note: Claude Sonnet, on claude-3 and claude-1 only.
Devin (SWE-2): the last resort. Its builds check themselves before any review.

strong.note: Claude Opus, on every Claude account.

claude-1.note: The Claude subscription the bot has always used; shared with its owner and bright-bots-harness, so it waits for quiet. Second in the usage order: Opus for strong roles, Sonnet for weak-tier builds.

claude-2.note: A second Claude account, capped at 90% of both its 5-hour session and its week. Kept back for planning and adversarial review on Opus: after the medium models in the usage order, and it builds only when no other subscription that may is free, Devin included (build_last). It never builds with Sonnet.

claude-3.note: A third Claude account, the bot's own: any hour, no caps. First in the usage order: Opus for strong roles, Sonnet for weak-tier builds.

claude-4.note: A fourth Claude account (token added 2026-10-04) with no weekly cap: any hour under 50% of its 5-hour session (off_hours), and from 03:00 to 15:00 Central (its window) up to 70% of it.

claude-5.note: A fifth Claude account (token added 2026-10-04): any hour, capped at 40% of its 5-hour session and 60% of its week.

claude-6.note: A sixth Claude account (token added 2026-10-05), same rules as claude-4 with no weekly cap: any hour under 50% of its 5-hour session (off_hours), and from 03:00 to 15:00 Central (its window) up to 70% of it.

gpt.note: ChatGPT through the Codex CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-gpt (`codex login`).

agy.note: Google's Antigravity CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-agy. Gemini 3.8 Flash (High); `agy models` lists the names, each carrying its effort. Its usage is its own `agy -p /usage` (no model call), the Gemini pool's row: read before the run, after every call and every ten minutes during one.

devin.note: Cognition's Devin CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-devin (`devin auth login --force-manual-token-flow`). SWE-2, its effort in the name; `devin models list` names the models. Weak, so it builds easy items only, and it takes them ahead of the stronger models while it has a free lane (easy_first).
devin.off_reason: SWE-2 is free on Devin's CLI only through 2026-10-16 (devin.ai/pricing). After that it draws on the Devin plan's daily and weekly allowance, at 6x (medium) to 12x (max) credits, so Devin needs a new model, caps, or to stay off.

muse.note: Meta's Muse Code CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-muse (`muse login`). Its usage is the TUI's `/usage` panel (`muse exec` runs no slash commands), read before the run, after every call and every ten minutes during one. Two lanes, `night-vm-muse` and `night-vm-muse-2`, under the one login.
